business_objective: Record branch cash-drawer handovers and close each handover after balances match and the receiving cashier acknowledges receipt.

stakeholder_statements.text: The outgoing cashier creates a cash-drawer handover record and identifies the drawer and service period.
The outgoing cashier records the declared closing balance.
The independent cash counter records the independently counted balance and whether it matches the declared balance.
The receiving cashier acknowledges receipt of the drawer and records any visible seal issue.
The branch control clerk closes the handover only after matching balances and receiving acknowledgement are recorded. Investigating suspected theft and depositing cash are outside this project.

business_objective: Record tip-pool allocations for eligible restaurant team members and close each pool after all assigned shares are acknowledged.

stakeholder_statements.text: The shift supervisor creates a tip-pool record and identifies the service period and eligible team members.
The cash reconciliation clerk records the total tip amount available for allocation.
The restaurant manager records an allocation share for each eligible team member.
Each team member acknowledges the assigned share.

The shift supervisor closes the tip-pool record only after every eligible team member has acknowledged the assigned share. Paying wages and resolving customer payment disputes are outside this project.

business_objective: Review supplier bid-security release requests and authorize eligible releases after procurement-stage, challenge, and security-availability checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A supplier representative submits a bid-security release request and identifies the procurement exercise and security record.
The tender clerk records whether the procurement stage permits release. The stages that permit release have not been agreed.
The challenge coordinator records whether a supplier challenge blocks release. The challenge categories that block release are undecided.
The finance custodian records the bid security as available for release or held and adds a reason when it is held.

The procurement officer marks the request authorized for release only after a release-permitted procurement stage, no blocking supplier challenge, and available bid security are recorded, then sends the outcome to the supplier representative. The delivery channel is undecided. Transferring funds, returning physical security documents, and changing the award decision are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to reclassify recorded grant expenditures between budget categories and update approved accounting classifications.

stakeholder_statements.text: A grant recipient finance officer submits a cost-reclassification request and identifies the award, expenditure, current budget category, and proposed budget category.
The program monitor records whether the expenditure relates to approved award activity.
The grant budget analyst records whether the proposed budget category may receive the expenditure. The eligibility criteria for budget categories have not been agreed.
The compliance reviewer records the request as approved or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The approval criteria are undecided.

The grant records clerk reclassifies the expenditure only after award-activity relation, destination-category eligibility, and approval are recorded, then sends the outcome to the grant recipient finance officer. The delivery channel is undecided. Moving money between bank accounts and amending the total award value are outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate support-case escalations while preserving an unresolved rule about whether ownership transfers to the specialist or remains with the original support agent.

stakeholder_statements.text: A support agent submits an escalation request and identifies the support case, escalation reason, and current case owner.
The triage lead records the escalation severity and whether specialist review is required. The severity criteria have not been agreed.

The escalation specialist records the request as accepted or declined and adds a reason when it is declined. The specialist says case ownership should transfer to the escalation specialist when the request is accepted.
The service quality reviewer records a handoff-risk assessment. The reviewer says the original support agent must remain the case owner until the escalation is closed.

The case operations coordinator records the case as escalated only after severity, specialist response, and handoff-risk assessment are present, then sends the escalation outcome to the original support agent. Nobody has decided who resolves the ownership disagreement, which delivery channel to use, or the maximum handoff time. Resolving the customer's issue and issuing refunds are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the break-room kettle.
